title: SICKLE Pretrained Models Technical Assessment & Feasibility Report

spectral_compatibility.resampling_required: Bicubic / Bilinear resampling to uniform 10m grid
spectral_compatibility.verdict: Fully compatible when all 12 bands are harmonized to 10m spatial resolution.

spatiotemporal_compatibility.temporal_depth: T timestamps (typically 12 to 32 clear observations across crop cycle)
spatiotemporal_compatibility.temporal_handling: Reflect padding or interpolation to uniform sequence length
spatiotemporal_compatibility.verdict: Compatible with multi-temporal clear-sky Sentinel-2 acquisitions.

sickle_micro_level.spatial_unit: Single agricultural field / survey plot patch (10.24 hectares)
sickle_micro_level.prediction_type: Continuous per-pixel yield in kg/acre (values ~1000 - 3500 kg/acre)
sickle_micro_level.ground_truth_source: Direct farmer harvest survey on individual geo-referenced plots

project_macro_level.prediction_type: Aggregate annual district rice yield in tonnes/ha (values ~2.5 - 5.5 t/ha)

domain_and_task_discrepancy.why_patch_cnn_cannot_directly_ingest_dis: Direct end-to-end training of a 3.1M-parameter 3D CNN on district-level census statistics is fundamentally ill-posed: an entire Tamil Nadu district comprises over 30,000,000 pixels (300,000 ha), yet the census provides only ONE scalar yield label per district-year. Assigning a single district-wide number to a 10-hectare plot patch causes extreme spatial label noise, completely ignores intra-district topography and irrigation differences, and destroys model convergence. Therefore, the rigorous approach is to aggregate Copernicus spectral vegetation features across agricultural zones for district-level census modeling (as implemented in copernicus_pipeline.py), while reserving SICKLE UNet3D strictly for plot-level crop type classification and field-level yield inference.

engineering_conclusion: The pretrained SICKLE UNet3D models were successfully verified, structurally validated, and executed in a controlled fine-tuning demonstration. However, because district census statistics represent macro aggregates over 300,000 hectares without pixel-level ground truth, direct patch-CNN training on district census yields is mathematically ill-posed. The complete production solution deploys the multi-spectral feature engineering pipeline (NDVI, NDRE, EVI, NDWI) for macro district-level census modeling, while reserving SICKLE UNet3D for micro plot-level rice yield and crop-type inference.
